detectionAlgorithm: TypeScript syntactic parse (ts.createSourceFile, no type-checker/Program) of each discovered file; relative ImportDeclaration specifiers resolved to on-disk files; caller/target domain classified via the checked-in domain map; a finding emitted per imported binding when caller domain != target domain.
